title: Standardize filter syntax to MongoDB-style and complete documentation
body:
## Filter Documentation & Code Standardization - COMPLETED ✅

### Issues Identified
- [x] Two different filter systems exist: array-based (old) vs MongoDB-style (new)
- [x] Documentation is incomplete and missing examples
- [x] All examples use the old array-based system
- [x] Operator naming is inconsistent
- [x] Report filters use a hybrid format
- [x] Build error fixed

### Documentation Updates Completed ✅
- [x] Update QueryFilter documentation with comprehensive examples
- [x] Update NormalizedFilter documentation with usage guide
- [x] Update FilterCondition documentation with real-world examples
- [x] Update FilterOperator documentation to align with new system and migration guide
- [x] Update FilterNode documentation with deprecation notice

### Code Updates Completed ✅
- [x] Update DashboardWidget schema to use FilterCondition
- [x] Update Report schema to use FilterCondition (removed old filter + filterItems)
- [x] Update all dashboard tests to use modern filter syntax
- [x] Update client-test.ts example to use MongoDB-style filters with correct 'filters' property
- [x] Update CRM dashboard filters (14 filters converted)
- [x] Update CRM report filters (6 reports converted)
- [x] Fix build error: changed 'where' to 'filters' in QueryOptions
- [x] All tests passing, build successful

### Summary of Changes
- **5 documentation files** updated with comprehensive examples and migration guides
- **3 schema files** updated to use FilterCondition
- **3 example files** updated to modern syntax
- **Build fixed** - all packages compile successfully

### Migration Notes
- Old array-based syntax: `[['field', '=', 'value']]` → New: `{ field: 'value' }`
- Old inequality: `[['stage', '!=', 'won'], ['stage', '!=', 'lost']]` → New: `{ stage: { $nin: ['won', 'lost'] } }`
- Old Report structure with filter + filterItems → New: single `filter` object with FilterCondition
- Client SDK uses `filters` property (not `where`) for MongoDB-style filters
